chunks: Ahmad ibn Idrees, from Muhammad ibn Hassan, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ammar ibn Marwan, from Munakhkhal, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

What! Whenever Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم came to you with that which your souls did not desire regarding the wilayah of Ali عليه السلام, you were arrogant; so a group from the family of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم you denied, and a group you killed.

key_terms.آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Ali عليه السلام, whose wilayah is being referred to
key_terms.فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ: you acted arrogantly and refused to submit
key_terms.كَذَّبْتُمْ: you denied and rejected as false
key_terms.مُوَالَاةِ: wilayah, devotion, and loyal allegiance in context

ai.seo_question: How does this verse relate to the wilayah of Ali عليه السلام and the rejection of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This narration presents an interpretive rendering of the verse as referring to rejection of the wilayah of Ali عليه السلام. It condemns arrogance before divine guidance and describes how some from the family of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم were denied while others were slain. In Shia tradition, it underscores the centrality of loyalty to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام in understanding revelation.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Hassan, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ammar Bin Marwan, from Munakhhal, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘

[2:87] What! Whenever Muhammadsaww came to you with that which your souls did not desire regarding Wilyaah of Aliasws you were arrogant so you belied a group from the Progeny of Muhammadsaww, and a group you slew?’.
en.sarwar: 31. Ahmad ibn Idris has narrated from Muhammad ibn Hassa’n from Muhammad ibn Ali from ‘Ammar ibn Marwan from Munakhkhal from Jabir from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following about the words of Allah. “Why do you arrogantly belie some of them (family of Muhammad (s.a) and murder others whenever he (Muhammad (s.a) would bring you messages (Imam Ali’s Leadership with Divine Authority) which you dislike? [2:87].”
